name: Coherence
description: Measures how logically the response follows from the previous exchange and maintains the topic of conversation.
scale: 1-5 (1: Not coherent at all, 5: Very coherent)

name: Relevance
description: Evaluates how well the response relates to the preceding statements and the overall context of the conversation.
scale: 1-5 (1: Not relevant at all, 5: Highly relevant)

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the level of interest and enthusiasm conveyed in the response, indicating how likely it is to encourage further conversation.
scale: 1-5 (1: Not engaging at all, 5: Very engaging)

name: Creativity
description: Rates the originality and novelty of the response, particularly in how it contributes uniquely to the conversation.
scale: 1-5 (1: Not creative at all, 5: Very creative)

name: Informative Value
description: Measures how much new or interesting information is provided in the response that adds depth to the conversation.
scale: 1-5 (1: Not informative at all, 5: Very informative)
